question: What was Ben-Hadad’s army doing when a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels?

readings.support: laid siege to Samaria | a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver

assessments.reason: Verse 24 states Ben-Hadad’s army “laid siege to Samaria,” and verse 25 describes the extreme prices during that siege, so “Laying siege to Samaria” matches the key.

reason: The text directly states the army was besieging Samaria at the time of the famine and exorbitant prices.
